hooks.description: Validate Kitchen Manager plugin code on file save
hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Write-Host 'Kitchen Manager: Validating code...'; php -l '{filePath}' 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Host '✓ Syntax valid' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '✗ Syntax errors detected' -ForegroundColor Red }"
hooks.windows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Write-Host 'Kitchen Manager: Validating code...'; php -l '{filePath}' 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Host '✓ Syntax valid' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '✗ Syntax errors detected' -ForegroundColor Red }"

hooks.description: Flag missing prepared statements in database queries
hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$content = Get-Content '{filePath}' -Raw; if ($content -match '\$wpdb->(get_results|get_row|query)\s*\(\s*[\"\']' -and $content -notmatch '\$wpdb->prepare') { Write-Host '⚠️  WARNING: Possible unprepared SQL query detected' -ForegroundColor Yellow }"
hooks.windows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$content = Get-Content '{filePath}' -Raw; if ($content -match '\$wpdb->(get_results|get_row|query)\s*\(\s*[\"\']' -and $content -notmatch '\$wpdb->prepare') { Write-Host '⚠️  WARNING: Possible unprepared SQL query detected' -ForegroundColor Yellow }"

hooks.description: Validate admin_post handlers have nonce verification
hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$content = Get-Content '{filePath}' -Raw; if ($content -match 'admin_post_' -and $content -notmatch 'wp_verify_nonce|check_admin_referer') { Write-Host '🔒 SECURITY: admin_post handler may be missing nonce verification' -ForegroundColor Magenta }"
hooks.windows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$content = Get-Content '{filePath}' -Raw; if ($content -match 'admin_post_' -and $content -notmatch 'wp_verify_nonce|check_admin_referer') { Write-Host '🔒 SECURITY: admin_post handler may be missing nonce verification' -ForegroundColor Magenta }"
